svg.text: > Which products sold the most last week on dev? Show revenue too.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: ⎿ customers 400 rows · orders 6,000 rows · order_items 12,000 rows · products 120 rows

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: ⎿ order_id bigint FK→orders.id · product_id int FK→products.id · qty int

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: "SELECT p.name, sum(i.qty) AS units, sum(i.qty * p.price) AS revenue

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: FROM shop.order_items i JOIN shop.products p ON p.id = i.product_id

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: JOIN shop.orders o ON o.id = i.order_id

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: WHERE o.placed_at >= $1::date - 7 GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 5")

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: ⎿ 5 rows · 14 ms · read-only transaction, rolled back
